notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just letting you all know that I finally adding trading cards to this game, after what feels like an eternity...

I also released a new update for this game a couple of days ago, which should fix a few spelling errors that were present in the original.

If you find any more spelling errors in this VN, or you have any problems, please let me know!

- ebi x

notes.title: New build
notes.content:
Hey guys~

If you see any more spelling errors or misc problems, please feel free to tell me!
